create_quantlinear_2bit: create a QuantLinear module with 2-bit quantization for a given infeatures and outfeatures size
create_quantlinear_4bit: create a QuantLinear module with 4-bit quantization and custom group size for model compression
pack_weights_248_bits: pack linear layer weights into 2, 4, or 8-bit quantized format using pack_248_bits method
pack_weights_3bits: pack linear layer weights into 3-bit quantized format using pack_3bits method with scales and zeros
run_quantlinear_forward: run forward pass through a QuantLinear module to compute quantized linear layer output
